arguments.summary: The 502 errors on the checkout page were due to an ingress idle timeout, not a database issue. Certificate expiration issues were resolved manually. Cron job scheduling issues were due to incorrect time zone settings. The `failed_jobs` table has 1388 entries, with 47 malformed rows, which will be exported using `pg_dump`.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Continue monitoring the `pg_dump` process and ensure it completes successfully. Once the export is complete, review the data in the `failed_jobs` table to understand the root cause of the job failures, and address the issues causing the job failures to get the backlog moving again.
